instruction: Directly edit the solder-mask and paste-mask rules in the native Altium PCB document `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\wifi_board.PcbDoc` instead of exporting an audit JSON. Save the modified native document as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\mask_rules.PcbDoc`. Requirements: - Keep the global `PasteMaskExpansion` rule scoped to `All` / `All`, but change `Expansion` to `1mil`. - Keep the local `SolderMaskExpansion` rule named `SolderMaskExpansion`, keep its scope as `HasPad('J2-M2')` / `All`, and change `Expansion` to `2mil`. - Both rules must remain enabled. - Do not reduce the task to external text processing; the evaluation checks the rule objects in the native `.PcbDoc`.
source: Local Altium example `Mini PC - WiFi/WiFi.PcbDoc`; benchmark task redesigned from text-only pad audit to native PCB rule editing.
